name: Futurepedia

sources.title: Batch-provided submission URL — returned HTTP 404 (route removed)
Homepage — AI tool directory (~4,000+ tools per site), newsletter, courses; no public free submit link in nav/footer
Update a Tool — editorial-team form for updating existing listings (the only public tool-request form found)
Third-party report (2026) — listings are paid-only: $247 basic verified listing (often sold out) or $497 verified listing with 1,000-click guarantee

requirements: AI tool that fits the directory's categories (image, business, automation, productivity, video, art, text, audio, code)
Third-party reporting says the free tier was dropped — listing runs $247 one-time (basic, frequently sold out) or $497 verified with editorial review and a click guarantee
Every submission is editorially reviewed; listed tools get a product page under /tool/<slug>
preparation: Square logo (256×256+), tagline under ~60 chars, ~100-word benefit-led description
3–5 screenshots (~1280×800), pricing details, demo video link if available
Correct category choice across Futurepedia's taxonomy
Budget approval for the paid listing tier
workflow: There is no public free submit form — start from futurepedia.io/contact or the paid-listing flow reached via their contact/advertise route (old /submit-tool 404s)
Choose a listing tier ($247 basic or $497 verified per third-party reports — confirm current pricing on the form)
Submit product details + media; editorial team reviews
Existing listings can be updated via /update-a-tool
watchFor: The batch's free/'submit-tool' claim is stale — the route is gone and third parties report paid-only since 2026
Outbound links from listings are reported as nofollow — value is the audience/newsletter, not link equity
$247 tier is frequently 'sold out' — the real entry price may effectively be $497
Advertiser disclosure on the site notes compensated links — editorial listings still get reviewed
countsAsLive: The tool has a public page at futurepedia.io/tool/<slug> appearing in its category and site search
unknowns: Current exact pricing — not published on a public page (contact form required)
Whether the Update a Tool form can be used to request a new listing
